description_en: Invokes the ListPolicies operation to list access policies
description_zh: 调用ListPolicies接口列出权限策略
name: ListPolicies

parameters.help_en: The type of the access policy. Valid values: `System` and `Custom`. If this parameter is not specified, all access policies are listed
parameters.help_zh: 指定`Policy`的类型，取值为`System`或`Custom`，如果没有指定则列出所有权限策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en: The marker. If the response is truncated, you can use `Marker` to obtain the content that starts from the position after the truncation point
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return. If the response is truncated because it reaches the `MaxItems` limit, the `IsTruncated` response parameter equals `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果的条数，当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于`true`。

取值范围：1 ~ 1000，默认值：100
parameters.name: max_items
